releaseNotes:
• Hybrid Gender & Whole-Body Semi-Nude Blur: Added PordaV4x3 YOLOv4-tiny gender detector fused with NudeNet for fast target-gender whole-body blurring on semi-nude exposure.
• Stronger Face Blurring: Thoroughly blurs target-gender faces when enabled while keeping opposite-gender faces clear.
• ContentGuard Protection Suite: Added local DNS VPN firewall, browser URL & visible text keyword blocking, custom App Blocker, 5-in-10m Auto-Lockout overlay, and 40s challenge + Master Password.
• Uninstall Protection Lifecycle: Defaults OFF on fresh install; once turned ON in Settings/Guard, persists across future APK updates and blocks uninstall/force-stop.
• R8-Optimized Signed v1.6 Release: Code & resource shrinking reduces arm64-v8a APK from 76.1 MB to 40.3 MB (hosted on GitHub Releases).
